extDescription.message: Download large files faster with adaptive multi-connection downloads, pause and resume. No extra software needed.

addPlaceholder.message: Paste one or more download links (http or https), one per line

settingsHint.message: Each download starts with the number of connections set above, and only uses fewer while the server refuses more, adding them back later. Browsers allow at most 6 connections per site (HTTP/1.1); HTTP/2 sites share one.

empty.message: No downloads yet. Paste a link above, right-click a link and choose "Download with Download Booster", or just download a large file as usual.

noRange.message: Server does not support split downloads; using a single connection

errNoSpace.message: Not enough disk space for this file

saveWriteFailed.message: Chrome could not write it to disk

saveTransient.message: the system kept refusing to write the file, often an antivirus or a sync tool holding it; choosing a download folder in Settings avoids this step

saveDenied.message: no permission to write to the Downloads folder

saveTooLarge.message: file too large for this disk

errRangeUnsupported.message: The file changed on the server; please download it again

invalidUrl.message: Please enter an http or https link

menuSniffPage.message: Find downloadable links on this page

sniffLinks.message: Find all links on this page

mediaEmpty.message: No video, audio or images found yet. Play the video or scroll the page, then open this again.

previewFailed.message: Can't play this here; it may still download fine.

errDrm.message: Protected by DRM, can't be downloaded

recordHint.message: This video can't be downloaded directly. Recording reloads the page, keeps everything the player loads from the start, and joins it into one file.

recordPlay.message: If the video hasn't started, press play on the page. Keep this tab open until it finishes.

recordDrm.message: This video is DRM-protected, so it can't be recorded.

renamePlaceholder.message: Rename, e.g. {title}_{n} — tokens {name} {n} {title} {host} {date}; empty keeps the original names

sniffRulesHint.message: Used by the toolbar popup and the page link list. Separate extensions with spaces or commas.

folderHintDefault.message: Files are first put together in the browser’s storage and then saved, so a large file briefly takes twice its size on disk. Pick a folder to have files written straight into it (a folder inside Downloads, e.g. Downloads/Download Booster: Chrome doesn’t allow Downloads itself).

folderHintOn.message: Files are written straight into this folder while they download (as “name.part” until done), and the progress is saved every so often. If a write is refused, the download picks up from the last save by itself; after a pause or a browser crash it continues from there too.

folderHintGrant.message: The browser needs your OK again to write to this folder. Until then new downloads go to the browser’s download folder.

folderUnsupported.message: This browser cannot save into a chosen folder.

folderNeedsGrant.message: the browser withdrew write access to this folder: click "Allow access" in Settings, then Retry; nothing is downloaded again

errFolder.message: Could not write to the download folder

checksumPlaceholder.message: MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 (optional), checked when done

mirrorsPlaceholder.message: Other addresses of the same file, one per line (optional); pieces are fetched from all of them

moreOneFile.message: A checksum and mirrors are for one link at a time.

badChecksum.message: That is not an MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256 checksum.

errChecksum.message: the file does not match the checksum (retry downloads it again)

folderPickSub.message: Chrome won’t let extensions use the Downloads, Desktop or Documents folder itself. Open it and pick or create a folder inside it, e.g. Downloads/Download Booster.

openFileFailed.message: The file can't be opened (moved or deleted?), so its folder is shown instead.

openFileAllowed.message: Allowed. Click Open again to open the file.

taskSearchPlaceholder.message: Search downloads by name or address

notifySetting.message: Show a notification when a download finishes or fails

notifyDenied.message: Notifications were not allowed, so none will be shown.

notifyClickManager.message: Click to open the download manager
